newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Morgan Stanley Asset Mgt opens Amsterdam office.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley Asset Mgt opens Amsterdam office.

text.p: Investment bank Morgan Stanley Group Inc. said on Thursday it had opened an office in Amsterdam as a branch of London-based Morgan Stanley Asset Management Ltd.

Morgan Stanley said the office would provide asset management and related services to Dutch and continental European clients. It said it would be headed by Frits Fiene who has 10 years of experience in pension fund management.
Morgan Stanley said that a heightened focus on pension provision and the approach of monetary union had led to greater demand in Europe for international investment expertise.
"The Netherlands, with the largest and most mature pension market in continental Europe, is an integral part of our strategy," it said in a statement.
